moves.name: Wield a Rarity
moves.triggerShort: When you make a move aided by an augmented asset.
moves.trigger:
When you **make a move aided by an augmented asset**, roll your rarity die in place of your action die.
- On **any result** with **6** showing on the rarity die: The power of the rarity manifests in a dramatic and obvious way. You score an automatic **strong hit** and take [+1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+1).
- On a **hit** with **5** showing on the rarity die: The power of the rarity manifests in a subtle way. Take [+1 momentum](resource:momentum?value=+1).
- On a **miss** with **1** showing on the rarity die: The rarity's power fails or works against you.
moves.notes: Replaces your action die (d6) with a rarity die (also d6) when invoking an augmented asset. Results depend on the face showing: 6 = automatic strong hit + momentum, 5 on a hit = momentum, 1 on a miss = power fails or backfires. Other results resolve normally.
